entities.name: PMID:25070816
observations: 2014 primary in vitro study titled “L-arginine enhances arginine deiminase induced human lymphoma cell growth inhibition through NF-kBp65 and p53 expression in vitro.”

entities.name: L-arginine
observations: Co-administered with arginine deiminase in Ramos human lymphoma cells at 10, 30, and 50 mM; supplementation enhanced ADI-induced growth inhibition dose-dependently in MTT assays.

entities.name: Arginine deiminase
observations: Tested at 0.01 U/mL in Ramos human lymphoma cells; L-arginine co-treatment enhanced its growth-inhibitory effect.

entities.name: Ramos lymphoma cells
observations: ADI-sensitive human lymphoma cell line used in the in vitro study.

entities.name: RELA
observations: NF-κB p65/RELA expression was assessed by Western blot and implicated in the dose-dependent response; accessible abstract does not specify direction of change.

entities.name: TP53
observations: p53/TP53 expression was assessed by Western blot and implicated in the dose-dependent response; accessible abstract does not specify direction of change.

entities.name: L-arginine enhances ADI inhibition
observations: In Ramos human lymphoma cells, L-arginine supplementation qualitatively enhanced ADI-induced growth inhibition in a dose-dependent manner by MTT cell-survival testing; no numerical effect size was available in the retrieved abstract.
